# Feedback and reach / 反馈与所及

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`feedback-and-reach` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](feedback-and-reach.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Feedback registers at most the influence closure, and a part registers where it reaches: in a balanced flow levels follow their exchanges, and whatever a part has not reached before a step is admitted alike with and without it there.
>
> 反馈至多识及影响闭包，部分在所到达之处被识：平衡的流中水平随其交换；在某步之前没有到达的，在该步有与无部分时同样被接纳。

## Laws / 规律

1. Two balanced flows that start a condition alike, and take from it and give to it the same totals at every step, keep it alike at every step. So a formation's support registers only the exchanges with what it depends on: on two webs that agree on what it requires and needs, two balanced flows that start, take and give alike on every condition it depends on support it alike at every step.<br>两个平衡的流在一个条件上起始相同、每步取用与给予的总量相同，就使它在每步相同。所以形成经支持只识得与其所依存者的交换：在其所需与依存一致的两个网上，两个平衡的流在它所依存的每个条件上起始、取用与给予相同，它在每步就同样被支持。 (`Becoming.Flow.Balances`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.levels_agree`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.support_agrees`)
2. With a part withheld, the levels with and without it agree on a condition at a step exactly when, before it, the part has given the condition what it has taken from it. Withholding a part that gives a condition nothing never lowers it, and withholding one that only takes registers as gain or nothing: what is supported with a part giving nothing to what it requires is admitted without it.<br>扣留一个部分时，有与无它的两种水平在某步于一个条件上相同，恰当此前部分向它给予的等于从它取用的。部分不向条件给予时，扣留它不降低条件；只取用的部分被扣留时只能是增益或无：有一个不向其所需给予的部分时被支持者，无它时也被接纳。 (`Becoming.Flow.WithheldLevels`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.withheld`, `Becoming.Web.Admits`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.agrees_iff_even`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.le_withheld`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.admits_without_taker`)
3. The levels with and without a part agree on a condition none of its members exchanges with, and where they differ at a step some member exchanged with it at an earlier step.<br>成员都不与条件交换时两种水平相同；某步不同之处，必有成员在更早的步与它交换。 (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.agrees_of_quiet`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.exchanges_before_of_differs`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.exchanges_of_differs`)
4. Nothing beyond a formation's influence closure exchanges with a condition a member depends on, so a part whose members all lie beyond it reaches nothing within it, and each formation within it is supported with the part exactly where the levels without the part admit it, at every step: whatever the part ends beyond the closure registers nowhere within it.<br>影响闭包之外的不与闭包成员所依存的条件交换，所以成员都在影响闭包之外的部分到达不了闭包之内，闭包之内的每个形成在每步有部分时被支持，恰当无部分的水平接纳它：部分在闭包之外终结的，在闭包之内都不被识。 (`Becoming.Flow.AffectedBy`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinInfluence`, `Becoming.Flow.beyond_influence`, `Becoming.Flow.unreached_within_influence`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.unregistered_beyond_influence`)
5. In Clearing the flow that spares the habitat also balances, with activity needing support. The clearer depends on its resource only and is supported alike at every step whether or not it clears the habitat, and active and supported throughout, while the dweller is active and supported at every step with the habitat spared and inactive from the third step on with it cleared.<br>Clearing 中不清除栖息地的流也平衡，活动需要支持。清除者只依存于其资源，清除与不清除栖息地时每步同样被支持，并始终活跃且被支持；而栖居者在不清除时每步活跃且被支持、清除时从第 3 步起不活跃。 (`Becoming.Clearing.sparedFlow`, `Becoming.Clearing.sparedWeb`, `Becoming.Clearing.resource_of_clearer`, `Becoming.Clearing.unregistered`)
6. A part reaches a formation when a member exchanges with a condition the formation depends on, and reaches it before a step when a member exchanged, at an earlier step, with a condition the formation requires at that step; what a part reaches before a step, it reaches.<br>部分到达一个形成，是指成员与它所依存的条件交换；在某步之前到达，是指成员在更早的步与它在该步所需的条件交换；在某步之前到达的，就是到达的。 (`Becoming.Flow.Reaches`, `Becoming.Flow.ReachesBefore`, `Becoming.Flow.ReachesBefore.reaches`)
7. At each condition a formation requires at a step, the levels with and without a part agree, or the part reaches the formation before that step; whatever the part has not reached before a step is admitted alike with and without it there, and what it does not reach, at every step.<br>形成在某步所需的每个条件上，两种水平相同，或部分在该步之前到达它；在某步之前没有到达的，在该步有与无部分时同样被接纳；没有到达的，每步都是这样。 (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.agrees_or_reaches_before`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.agrees_or_reaches`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.admits_unreached_before`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.admits_unreached`)
8. In Late an exchange after the dependence affects and reaches a formation without reaching it before any step, and the formation is supported, and admitted without the part, at every step.<br>Late 中交换在依存之后：形成被影响、被到达，却在每步之前都没有被到达；它每步都被支持，无部分时也被接纳。 (`Becoming.Late.flow`, `Becoming.Late.web`, `Becoming.Late.latePart`, `Becoming.Late.affected_without_effect`)
9. What a part whose members lie within a region closed under affecting reaches lies within the region; the reach closure and the system are such regions, and a part whose members all lie beyond a system reaches nothing within it.<br>成员在一个对影响封闭的区域之内的部分只到达区域之内；所及闭包与系统都是这样的区域，成员都在系统之外的部分到达不了系统之内。 (`Becoming.Flow.Affects`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinReach`, `Becoming.Flow.WithinSystem`, `Becoming.Flow.reaches_within_closed`, `Becoming.Flow.reaches_withinReach`, `Becoming.Flow.reaches_withinSystem`, `Becoming.Flow.unreached_within_system`)
10. A formation's own part has its members within its reach closure and its system; the clearer's part is its own and reaches the dweller.<br>形成自身的部分，其成员在其所及闭包与系统之内；清除者的部分是它自身的，并到达栖居者。 (`Becoming.Flow.own_within_reach`, `Becoming.Flow.own_within_system`, `Becoming.Clearing.clearerPart`, `Becoming.Clearing.clearer_own`, `Becoming.Clearing.reaches_dweller`)

## Conditions / 条件

- The general theorems assume only balance (Flow.Balances); a part is a decided family of formations.<br>一般定理的前提只有平衡（Flow.Balances）；部分是判定的形成家族。
- Comparisons with and without a part use withheld levels (Flow.WithheldLevels): the levels with the part withheld and the rest of the exchange unchanged, a choice of the representation; a comparison of two flows is given the second flow.<br>有与无一个部分的比较用扣留水平（Flow.WithheldLevels）：扣留这一部分、其余交换不变时的水平，这是表示上的选择；两个流的比较另给第二个流。
- Closures, influence, sharing and reach are at the level of formations: the exchange and the dependence each hold at some step, not necessarily the same one, in any temporal order; the comparison theorems use Flow.ReachesBefore, which is ordered in time.<br>闭包、影响、共享与所及都是形成层面的：交换与依存各在某一步，不要求同一步，也不按时间先后；比较定理用按时间先后的 Flow.ReachesBefore。
- For the Clearing and Late results: the witnesses' flows and webs (Clearing.flow, Clearing.web, Clearing.sparedFlow, Clearing.sparedWeb, Late.flow, Late.web).<br>Clearing 与 Late 的结论：见证的流与网（Clearing.flow、Clearing.web、Clearing.sparedFlow、Clearing.sparedWeb、Late.flow、Late.web）。
- Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.<br>离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。

## Does not show / 未表明

- Does not show that a formation knows its reach closure or wants anything.<br>不推出形成知道其所及闭包或想要任何东西。
- One act of a formation is compared only through a second flow, as in Clearing.unregistered.<br>一个形成的某一动作只能经第二个流比较，如 Clearing.unregistered。 Witness: `Becoming.Clearing.unregistered`.
- Responding flows are supplied in the witnesses.<br>回应的流在见证中是给出的。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** The comparison by withheld levels keeps the rest of the exchange fixed, while the influence closure is motivated by effects passing through others: with the rest fixed only the parts that reach a formation directly register (Flow.Balances.admits_unreached), and the wolves' effect on the forest through the deer does not appear (Trophic.mediated_unregistered; see comparison-within-reach); the influence closure is an upper bound, not a characterization of what registers.<br>以扣留水平的比较固定其余交换，影响闭包的动机来自经他者传递的影响：其余交换固定时，只有直接到达的部分被识（Flow.Balances.admits_unreached），狼群经鹿对森林的作用在其中不出现（Trophic.mediated_unregistered，见 comparison-within-reach）；影响闭包是上界，不是所识者的刻画。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Feedback.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. 不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. 不含伦理谓词，不评价生起或消失。 · Stated for discrete steps. 按离散步骤陈述。 · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse. 名称依 Ren 2026年10月10日的命名标准，在陈述有其确切意义处采用（Ren，2026年10月12日）；未注明属于 Ren 的读法，依 Ren 2026年10月15日的交托由 AI 决定，Ren 可以改动。

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren's long-term objectives: “I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”; Ren asked to “pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”. Ren's levels: “i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”. The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): the influence closure reads what a formation's own feedback can register once effects pass through the support and activity of others; the reach closure reads Ren's intermediate “the system that one is in” (the feeding closure was earlier read as the system one is in; that reading is withdrawn); the system, the closure under sharing a condition, bounds every effect but does not read that level: one common condition makes it the whole, and systems partition the formations, with no nesting and no center; “situational awareness” reads as a center knowing what its part reaches beyond its feedback. The names (ClosedUnder, WithinClosure, AffectedBy, WithinInfluence, Affects, WithinReach, TakesPart, Shares, WithinSystem, Reaches, ReachesBefore, DiffersBefore, Trophic and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard; trophic cascade is the ecological term.<br>Ren 的长远目标：“I want to push the frontier as strong as possible, in terms of human knowledge, or have the full truth set(still need situational awareness), the universal ethics”；Ren 要求“pursue the strongest claims and complete proof”。Ren 的层级：“i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”。作者的读法（AI 论证，依 Ren 的交托采用）：影响闭包读一个形成自身的反馈在效果经他者的支持与活动传递时所能识的；所及闭包读 Ren 中间的“the system that one is in”（供给闭包曾被读作所在系统，这一读法已撤回）；系统（对共享条件的闭包）界定每个效果，却不读那一层级：一个共同条件就使它成为整体，系统划分形成，没有嵌套与中心；“situational awareness”读作中心知道其部分在反馈之外所到达的。名称（ClosedUnder、WithinClosure、AffectedBy、WithinInfluence、Affects、WithinReach、TakesPart、Shares、WithinSystem、Reaches、ReachesBefore、DiffersBefore、Trophic 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选；营养级联是生态学用语。
